cells.gaps: A framing meeting on 4 November 2026 opened the drafting of a national digital transformation strategy with UNDP support (TCD-039); no adoption, text, period, plan or reporting is held for it. The World Bank's 2023 diagnostic recommended adopting a Chad Digital Strategy Horizon 2030 (TCD-004), and the Stratégie nationale de transformation numérique 2020-2030 that ADETIC and others name to 2026 (TCD-001, TCD-006, TCD-008) has no row on its standing or text. The same report's statement of absence (TCD-003) is answered by its own recommendation, so stage 1 does not hold.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-07: drafting of a national digital transformation strategy opened on 4 November 2026, so the strategy is in preparation and advancing. Stage 3 needs a source's word of adoption and a public text.
